title: Salesforce Developer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: We are seeking a skilled and proactive Salesforce Developer with 2-4 years of hands-on experience. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing customized Salesforce solutions that align with business goals. 
 Key Responsibilities: Develop and maintain custom Salesforce applications using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, and Flows. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions. Customize Salesforce objects, fields, page layouts, workflows, and validation rules to support real estate business processes. Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment activities. Provide ongoing support and enhancements to existing Salesforce implementations. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications: 2-4 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development. Understanding of Salesforce configuration and customization. Strong proficiency in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and SOQL. Experience with Salesforce integrations using REST/SOAP APIs. Familiarity with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud. Good problem-solving and communication skills. 
 Location- Ajmer Work from office Immediate Joiner or 15 Days Notice Period

Key Skills: Lightning Components,Lwc,Triggers,Apex,SDLC Life Cycle,Aura,Sales force development,Lightning
